verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's marketing site describes built-in AI: agents that monitor the product and recommend next steps (docs-44), AI that spots trends across replays and heatmaps (docs-21), AI summaries of replay playlists (docs-27), and change diagnosis delivered as a dashboard (docs-15). This suggests in-product AI, but it reads as proactive insight features rather than a documented assistant users can hand tasks to. The MCP server and its natural-language queries serve external AI assistants, so they do not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: first-party docs of an in-product assistant that accepts user-delegated tasks, details on what actions it can perform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
